contract.outputAndReadback: Check target minima and projected parameters; group 71/group 73 counts; ordered style tuples in groups 49/62/6; group 340 identity; consumer group 74/group 41/group 75 arrays; and fresh style/consumer readback in model space and a named block.
contract.failureAndRetry: For each source count, verify unsupported-flags refusal and late-live-consumer-mutation refusal for ASCII and binary output. Each refusal preserves the sentinel destination; caller snapshots are restored/unchanged as required; the corrected state succeeds on the same adapter.
contract.boundary: Source count 252 reaches target 255. Source count 253 plus three tuples would require target count 256 and is outside the positive profile; this receipt does not claim a serialized 256-count refusal test.

focusedTests.summary: All source-count cases passed across all four source/output encodings with output/readback and refusal/retry controls.

limits: Only the selected generated tuple recipe, AC1027 route, and ordinary source-bound consumers are qualified.
Other tuple sequences, batches larger than three from non-two source counts, removals, count-71 field edits, angle/offset/flag variants, other carriers, versions, and native semantics remain open.
This does not qualify complete-document closure, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3/FreeCAD meaning, independent external semantics, or 3D support.
